question: Which three types of preassembled flows can be utilized from the Financial Services Cloud (FSC) packages and the Lightning Flow for FSC package? (Choose three.) A. Insurance flow B. Commercial Banking flow C. Mortgage flow D. Institutional Banking flow E. Retail Banking flow

A consulting firm is asked to add Events and Milestones to a Lightning record page to give financial advisors deeper insights into their customers’ lives. What should the consultant configure to enable advisors to capture Once-in-a-Lifetime events and, at the same time, prevent users from accidentally creating more than one event of such an event type? A. Single event types B. Unique event types C. Once-in-a-Lifetime event types D. Special event types

Cumulus Bank has implemented Compliant Data Sharing in Financial Services Cloud. Which two things happen when an opportunity record that has opportunity participants with associated share table entries is set to Private? (Choose two.) A. Share table records need to be manually deleted. B. The share table records are deleted. C. The opportunity participant records are not deleted. D. All opportunity participant records are deleted.

To use the OmniScript metadata type, what should the administrator enable in the Salesforce org? A. Discovery Framework B. Custom Domain C. Einstein Relationship Insights D. Lightning Experience for Financial Services Cloud

A Financial Services Cloud (FSC) administrator is setting up a permission set for Actionable Relationship Center. Which license should the administrator select on the Permission Set setup page? A. OmniStudio B. FSC Extension C. FSC Basic D. FSC Standard

Which three related lists are visible within Actionable Relationship Center associated with the Account object? (Choose three.) A. Notes and Attachments B. Cases C. Client Financial Goals D. Household Financial Accounts E. Financial Holdings

A Financial Services Cloud (FSC) administrator wants to create a new FSC permission set that includes the Access Interest Tags for Financial Services Cloud permission. Which two permission sets should be cloned to create this new permission set and give access to interest tags? (Choose two.) A. FSC Basic permission set B. FSC Extension permission set C. FSC Foundations permission set D. FSC Standard permission set

The Bank of the Future wants its call center agents to be able to see person accounts but wants to restrict access to financial accounts to protect the privacy of its clients. Which two steps should an administrator take to ensure that all users can see person accounts but only specific users can view financial accounts? (Choose two.) A. Chance organization-wide defaults (OWD) sharing on the Financial Accounts object to Private B. Edit the Lightning page assigned to the Financial Advisor Profile and remove the Financial Accounts tab. C. Change organization-wide defaults (OWD) sharing on the Financial Accounts abject to Public Read Only. D. Change organization-wide defaults (OWD) sharing on the Person Accounts object to Public Read Only.

Culumus Insurance has a franchise business model with a large number of franchisees who operate independently but report to regional managers who are Cumulus employees. The company would like the franchise owners and their employees to have access to the Culumus Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) instance. The company plans to use the Role Hierarchy and sharing rules to implement this. What should the architect at Cumulus Insurance be aware of for this solution? A. Franchise users will need to switch their browsers to a platform that supports Lightning Web Components. B. Franchise users can have multiple roles in the hierarchy. C. The administrator can define up to 300 total sharing rules for each object. D. Salesforce FSC only allows 1,024 public groups.
